product_metadata.title: Serafina Home Calais Boho Shower Curtain for Bathroom: Fabric Floral Paisley Moroccan Damask Design
features: Sophisticated print with bring a splash of design to you bathroom tub.
Material: 100% polyester cloth; Dobby jacquard weave is an elegant addition.
Easy Care: Machine washable; Dryer friend on low.
It will match well with various color palates of towels, rugs, bathroom mats and any other bathroom accessories.
description: Beautifully designed, this Bohemian inspired floral damask fabric shower curtain drapes gracefully around the bathtub. Elegant and unique the Calais shower curtain can be the centerpiece of your bathroom. It pairs well with other bathroom home decor as well as shower curtain liners. This is a versatile shower curtain which can also be used as a window panel and as other creative decorative decor.
